pairs: Et erat vir habitans in Babylone,
And there was a man living in Babylon,
And he received a wife named Susanna,
erudierunt filiam suam secundum legem Moysi.
had educated their daughter according to the law of Moses.
et erat ei pomarium vicinum domui suæ:
and he had an orchard near his house,
and the Jews flocked to him,
because he was the most honorable of them all.
Et constituti sunt de populo duo senes judices in illo anno,
And two elder judges had been appointed among the people that year,
about whom the Lord has said,
Quia egressa est iniquitas de Babylone a senioribus judicibus,
“Iniquity has come out of Babylon, from the elder judges,
who seemed to govern the people.”
These frequented the house of Joakim,
et veniebant ad eos omnes qui habebant judicia.
and all came to them, who had need of judgment.
Cum autem populus revertisset per meridiem,
But when the people departed at noontime,
et deambulabat in pomario viri sui.
and walked around in her husband’s orchard.
Et videbant eam senes quotidie ingredientem et deambulantem,
And the elders saw her entering and walking around every day,
and they were inflamed with desire towards her.
And they perverted their reason and turned away their eyes,
et declinaverunt oculos suos ut non viderent cælum,
so that they would not look to heaven,
nor call to mind just judgments.
Erant ergo ambo vulnerati amore ejus,
And so they were both wounded by the love of her,
nec indicaverunt sibi vicissim dolorem suum:
yet they did not reveal their grief to one another.
erubescebant enim indicare sibi concupiscentiam suam,
For they were ashamed to reveal to each other their desire,
Et observabant quotidie sollicitius videre eam.
And so they watched carefully every day to see her.
And one said to the other,
they came to the same place,
and, each asking the other the reason,
et tunc in communi statuerunt tempus quando eam possent invenire solam.
And then they agreed to set a time when they would be able to find her alone.
while they watched for an opportune day,
that she entered at a particular time,
just as yesterday and the day before,
and she wanted to wash in the orchard,
And there was no one there,
except the two elders in hiding,
And so she said to the maids,
and shut the doors of the orchard,
And they did as she ordered them.
And they shut the doors of the orchard
et egressæ sunt per posticum ut afferrent quæ jusserat;
and left through a back door to fetch what she required,
and they did not know that the elders were hiding within.
But when the maids had departed,
“Behold, the doors of the orchard are closed,
and no one can see us,
et nos in concupiscentia tui sumus:
and we are in desire for you.
quam ob rem assentire nobis, et commiscere nobiscum.
Because of these things, consent to us and lie with us.
we will bear witness against you that a young man was with you and,
et ob hanc causam emiseris puellas a te.
you sent your maids away from you.”
“I am closed in on every side.
For if I do this thing,
yet if I do not do it,
I will not escape your hands.
Sed melius est mihi absque opere incidere in manus vestras,
But it is better for me to fall unavoidably into your hands,
than to sin in the sight of the Lord.”
And Susanna cried out with a loud voice,
exclamaverunt autem et senes adversus eam.
but the elders also cried out against her.
Et cucurrit unus ad ostia pomarii,
And one of them hurried to the door of the orchard
Cum ergo audissent clamorem famuli domus in pomario,
And so, when the servants of the house heard the outcry in the orchard,
irruerunt per posticum ut viderent quidnam esset.
they rushed in by the back door to see what was happening.
But after the old men had spoken,
quia numquam dictus fuerat sermo hujuscemodi de Susanna.
for there had never been anything of this kind said about Susanna.
And it happened on the next day,
Cumque venisset populus ad Joakim virum ejus,
when the people came to Joakim her husband,
that the two appointed elders also came,
full of wicked plans against Susanna,
pleni iniqua cogitatione adversus Susannam ut interficerent eam.
in order to put her to death.
And they said before the people,
Mittite ad Susannam filiam Helciæ uxorem Joakim.
“Send for Susanna, daughter of Hilkiah, the wife of Joakim.”
And immediately they sent for her.
And she arrived with her parents,
Susanna was exceedingly delicate and beautiful in appearance.
At iniqui illi jusserunt ut discooperiretur (erat enim cooperta),
But those wicked ones commanded that her face should be uncovered,
so that at least they might be satisfied with her beauty.
her own and all who knew her wept.
Consurgentes autem duo presbyteri in medio populi,
Yet the two appointed elders, rising up in the midst of the people,
posuerunt manus suas super caput ejus.
set their hands upon her head.
And weeping, she gazed up to heaven,
erat enim cor ejus fiduciam habens in Domino.
for her heart had faith in the Lord.
“While we were taking a walk in the orchard alone,
ingressa est hæc cum duabus puellis:
this one came in with two maids,
and she shut the doors of the orchard,
and she sent the maids away from her.
And a young man came to her,
and he lay down with her.
Porro nos cum essemus in angulo pomarii,
Furthermore, since we were in a corner of the orchard,
and we saw them consorting together.
Et illum quidem non quivimus comprehendere,
And, indeed, we were unable to catch him,
because he was stronger than us,
and opening the doors, he leaped out.
But, since we had apprehended this one,
we demanded to know who the young man was,
but she was unwilling to tell us.
On this matter, we are witnesses.”
just as if they were elders and the judges of the people,
and they condemned her to death.
But Susanna cried out with a loud voice
who knows all things before they happen,
tu scis quoniam falsum testimonium tulerunt contra me:
you know that they have borne false witness against me, and behold,
et ecce morior, cum nihil horum fecerim,
I must die, though I have done none of these things,
quæ isti malitiose composuerunt adversum me.
which these men have maliciously invented against me.”
But the Lord heeded her voice.
And when she was led away to death,
suscitavit Dominus spiritum sanctum pueri junioris,
the Lord raised up the holy spirit of a young boy,
And he cried out with a loud voice,
Mundus ego sum a sanguine hujus.
“I am clean of the blood of this one.”
Et conversus omnis populus ad eum,
“What is this word that you are saying?”
Qui cum staret in medio eorum,
But he, while standing in the midst of them,
“Are you so foolish, sons of Israel,
non judicantes, neque quod verum est cognoscentes,
that without judging and without knowing what the truth is,
you have condemned a daughter of Israel?
quia falsum testimonium locuti sunt adversus eam.
because they have spoken false witness against her.”
Reversus est ergo populus cum festinatione,
Therefore, the people returned with haste,
and the old men said to him,
et sede in medio nostrum, et indica nobis:
“Come and sit down in our midst and show us,
quia tibi Deus dedit honorem senectutis.
since God has given you the honor of old age.”
“Separate these at a distance from one another,
and I will judge between them.”
Cum ergo divisi essent alter ab altero,
And so, when they were divided, one from the other,
now your sins have come out,
‘The innocent and the just you must not put to death.’
dic sub qua arbore videris eos colloquentes sibi.
declare under which tree you saw them conversing together.”
Recte mentitus es in caput tuum:
you have lied against your own head.
For behold, the angel of God,
having received the sentence from him,
will split you down the middle.
he commanded the other to approach,
and desire has perverted your heart.
Thus did you do to the daughters of Israel,
and they, out of fear, consorted with you,
sed filia Juda non sustinuit iniquitatem vestram.
but a daughter of Judah would not tolerate your iniquity.
dic mihi sub qua arbore comprehenderis eos loquentes sibi.
declare to me, under which tree you caught them conversing together.” He said,
Recte mentitus es et tu in caput tuum:
you also have lied against your own head.
For the angel of the Lord waits,
to cut you down the middle and put you to death.”
Exclamavit itaque omnis cœtus voce magna,
And then the entire assembly cried out in a loud voice,
who saves those who hope in him.
Et consurrexerunt adversus duos presbyteros (convicerat enim eos Daniel ex ore suo falsum dixisse testimonium), feceruntque eis sicut male egerant adversus proximum,

And they rose up against the two appointed elders, (for Daniel had convicted them, by their own mouth, of bearing false witness,) and they did to them just as they had wickedly done against their neighbor,
so as to act according to the law of Moses.
And they put them to death,
et salvatus est sanguis innoxius in die illa.
and innocent blood was saved on that day.
Helcias autem et uxor ejus laudaverunt Deum pro filia sua Susanna cum Joakim marito ejus,
But Hilkiah and his wife praised God for their daughter, Susanna, with Joakim,
her husband, and all her relatives,
quia non esset inventa in ea res turpis.
because there had been found in her no disgrace.
Daniel autem factus est magnus in conspectu populi a die illa,
And so Daniel became great in the sight of the people from that day,
Et rex Astyages appositus est ad patres suos,
And king Astyages was laid to rest with his fathers.
et suscepit Cyrus Perses regnum ejus.
And Cyrus the Persian received his kingdom.
